VVCC Wednesday Cottonwood Ride

Cottonwood, AZ

VVCC Wednesday Cottonwood Ride is a road group ride in Cottonwood, AZ. It meets every Wednesday, 8:00 am, starting at The Neighborhood Coffee Shop. Expect about 14–50 miles, 10–20 mph depending on the week.

About the VVCC Wednesday Cottonwood Ride group ride

A midweek road ride in the Verde Valley from a Cottonwood coffee shop, with coffee back at the shop afterward. The same club also rides Tuesdays from Old Town Cottonwood and Thursdays from Sedona. Non-members can try one ride before joining.
